results.title: Estonia will close border with Russia 'to secure Europe,' foreign minister says during Baku visit

results.title: Relatives say jailed Iranian twins beaten and tortured, one faces execution
results.content: Taraneh, 21, had been held in enforced disappearance for more than three months and tortured into a confession, according to rights groups.
